notes: Safety: the full key test (every key played and listened to) now runs only after the power was cut for a fault; other safety checks are quick and silent. After a fault the piano stays off for a 25-minute cool-down (Skip the cool-down in Piano > Power plug, behind the PIN). Power trips now allow an 80 W leeway: only 80 W more than the notes and idle explain cuts the 24 V; the controller's own checks still cut at once.
